name: iter7_schedules
description: EXPERIMENT B at a 7-ITERATION HORIZON. Identical to iter20_schedules except the loop runs 7 rounds. This is a separate experiment, NOT the first 7 rounds of the 20-round run: a linear schedule is defined relative to the horizon it is given, so over 7 rounds sigma widens and alpha decays roughly 2.9x faster per round and reaches the same endpoints by round 7. Truncating the 20-round run would show a much gentler schedule. (For the constant-schedule anchor, truncation IS exact, so no separate short-horizon run is needed there.) 15 seeds, one detector, new-only regime.
